div.font: (1) Formula bar shows =XLOOKUP(B2,SalesOrder!A:A,SalesOrder!D:D), which retrieves the OrderDate from the SalesOrder worksheet by matching on SalesOrderID. Column I uses =IF(C2<H2,"Check","OK") to flag anomalies. (2) The "Check" result in row 3 flags a record where ShipmentDate (July 1) precedes OrderDate (July 8), indicating a potential accuracy problem.

font.i: Production: Capture from CharlesRiver.xlsx, Shipment worksheet with helper columns H and I added. Show formula bar with H2 selected. Add coral highlight on anomaly row and blue callout markers per spec.
